info.title: mailless administration API
info.description: Accounts, addresses and shares for administrators, and each user’s own password, passkeys and app passwords. Every call needs an access token of the identity provider as a bearer token.

tags.name: me
tags.description: What a signed-in user does for themself.

tags.name: accounts
tags.description: What an administrator does. Needs the administrator role.

bearer.description: An access token of the identity provider.

account.description: Null for a user who has no mailbox.

items.description: name@domain, or *@domain for a whole domain.

usage.description: Null for a user who has no mailbox.

passkeyEnrolmentUrl.description: The page of the identity provider where a passkey is added, when it has one.

id.description: Small letters, digits, "-" and "_". Never changes.

quotaOctets.description: The limit this account was given, in bytes. Null when it has none of its own and gets what every account gets.

usedOctets.description: How much the mailbox holds, in bytes. Null when it has not been counted yet, which it is the first time the account is used.

limitOctets.description: How much it may hold, in bytes: the account's own limit, or else the one every account gets. Null when there is no limit.

error.description: What went wrong, as a word a program can act on: invalid, unauthorized, forbidden, notFound, exists, addressTaken, invalidPassword, notAuthorized, rateLimited, unsupported.

enabled.description: Whether a code from an authenticator app is asked for at sign-in.

secret.description: What to put in the authenticator app (RFC 6238, in base 32). Shown once.

code.description: The six digits the app shows now.

secret.description: Shown this once. It cannot be read again.

items.description: name@domain, or *@domain for a whole domain.

shares.description: Who else may use the account, by user.

sharedWith.description: The other accounts this user may use, by account.

canSignIn.description: Whether the identity provider has an enabled user for it.

id.description: Small letters, digits, "-" and "_". Never changes.

quotaOctets.description: A limit of its own for this account, in bytes, or null to go back to what every account gets.

temporary.description: A temporary password must be replaced by the user when they first sign in.

delete.description: The user can no longer sign in, the addresses stop delivering, the app passwords are revoked and the account is no longer shared. Its mail is then removed, which takes a few minutes or more; until that is done the account stays listed as "deleting", so that its id cannot be given to someone else while its mail still exists. Closing an account that is already "deleting" asks for the removal again.
